param name="title"     type="string"  default="";
param name="pageSize"  type="numeric" default=10;
param name="sortOrder" type="string"  default="asc";
param string mode = 'list';
param numeric offset = 0;
param name="format"   type="string";
param name="callback" type="string";
param Name="q"        TYPE="string";

component accessors="true" {

    property name="title" type="string"  required;
    property name="count" type="numeric" required;
    property name="items"       type="array";
    property name="labels"      type="array"; // trailing
    // a comment between two members does not end the run
    property name="description" type="string";
    property name="summary" /* note */ type="string";
    property name="notes"   type="string";
    property name="tagline" type="string";

    property name="id" type="any" default="" required;
    property
        name="createdDate"
        type="any"
        default=""
        required;

    property name="shortName"       inject="id";
    property name="settingsService" inject="coldbox:setting:someRatherLongSettingName";
    property name="log"             inject="logbox:logger:{this}";

    function init() {
        param name="arguments.a"   default="";
        param name="arguments.bcd" default="x";
        return this;
    }

}
